form.codeHint: 2–10 letters and digits, e.g. BDG01. Printed in receipt numbers.
form.hoursHint: Fill in both, or leave both empty. A closing time before the opening time means past midnight.
form.localeHint: For receipts, and for users who haven't chosen their own language.

list.title: Outlets
list.empty: No outlets yet. Add your first one.

create.title: Add outlet
create.intro: A new outlet comes with a Cashier role. Once it's saved, add its Manager.

detail.title: Outlet details
detail.noManagers: This outlet has no Manager yet.
detail.managersHint: Open a Manager's account to reset their password, deactivate it, or make them staff again. Another user becomes a Manager from the Users tab.
detail.activeBody: The outlet is active: its users can sign in and its cashiers can check out.
detail.inactiveBody: The outlet is inactive: its users can't sign in. Its data and reports stay.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: The outlet's users are signed out at once and can't sign in, and its cashiers can't check out. Data and reports stay, and you can activate the outlet again at any time.

activate.title: Activate {{name}}?
activate.body: The outlet's users can sign in again, and its cashiers can check out again.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The outlet leaves the list and its code can't be used again. Its transactions stay on record.
